title: Sharp Rise in Number of Afghans Fleeing Conflict

image.attribution: Evan Bench from paris, france / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-2.0

main_content:
The number of Afghans displaced within their country has increased over the past three years, says Amnesty International.

The rights group reported on Tuesday that Afghanistan has 1.2 million displaced people. That is almost double the number in 2013.

Champa Patel is Amnesty International’s South Asia Director. She said that growing numbers of displaced Afghans are living in very bad conditions.

In recent years, Afghanistan’s central government has promised to help displaced people. But these Afghans still lack food, water, health care, and chances to seek education and employment, Amnesty said.

Amnesty International has called on Afghan officials and the international community to act quickly.
